items.name: CubingUSA Western Championship 2021

venue.name: Utah Valley Convention Center
venue.address: 220 West Center Street, Suite 200 Provo UT, 84601
venue.details: Ballrooms A & B (Main Room) and Cascade E (Side Room)

items.information:
Featuring 17 different events, competitors from American Samoa, Arizona, California, Colorado, Guam, Hawaii, Nevada, Northern Mariana Islands, and Utah will be eligibile for the title of Western Champion!

Competitors are expected to read the [Risk Management Plan](https://drive.google.com/file/d/17-6sCbfIQ2rT6dley5RiPhzLnXZDq8lL/view?usp=sharing) for this competition as well as the [WCA Competition Safety Policy](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/documents/policies/external/Competition%20Safety.pdf).
